The modifications in the file are interconnected as they all aim to improve the readability and maintainability of the code. By introducing the `key` and `updown` variables, the logic of the key event handling becomes clearer, allowing future developers to understand the code without needing to interpret hexadecimal values directly. This change also aligns with the goal of fixing the hotkey double trigger bug by ensuring that the key event processing is more straightforward and less error-prone. Overall, the refactoring enhances both the functionality and the clarity of the code.
